poLines.saveFailed: Failed to save the purchase order.
poLines.lineSaveFailed: Failed to save the purchase order line.
poLines.lineAddFailed: Failed to add the purchase order line.
poLines.lineDeleteFailed: Failed to delete the purchase order line.

poList.title: Purchase Orders
poList.searchPlaceholder: Search by PO number, supplier, or job number...

titles.jobs: The jobs this order's lines are for. Lines with no job aren't counted.
titles.orderDate: The date the order was raised in DocketWorks.
titles.status: Draft: not sent to the supplier yet. Submitted to Supplier: sent and in Xero. Partially / Fully Received: some or all of the ordered quantities have arrived. Deleted: cancelled.
titles.createdBy: The staff member who raised the order.

poCreate.title: Create Purchase Order
poCreate.createFailed: Failed to create the purchase order.

poDetail.loadFailed: Could not load the purchase order.

poDocumentActions.allowPopups: Allow pop-ups for this site to open the supplier email.
poDocumentActions.emailFailed: Failed to draft the supplier email.
poDocumentActions.noSupplierEmail: This supplier has no email address on file

poSummary.title: Purchase Order {{number}}
poSummary.statusLabelTitle: Changing the status updates the order in Xero. Choosing Fully Received receives everything still outstanding: each line goes to its job, or into workshop stock if it has no job. Receiving goods sets Partially or Fully Received automatically.

statusTitles.draft: Not sent to the supplier yet.
statusTitles.submitted: The order has gone to the supplier. DocketWorks puts it in Xero at this point so the supplier's bill can be matched to it.
statusTitles.partiallyReceived: Some of the ordered quantities have arrived.
statusTitles.fullyReceived: All of the ordered quantities have arrived.
statusTitles.deleted: The order is cancelled. If it's already in Xero it is deleted there too; it is never added to Xero.

poSummary.totalTitle: Quantity times unit cost, added up over every line with a description. It shows "Known subtotal" while any line has no cost yet, because those lines aren't included.
poSummary.unpricedTitle: Lines marked as cost to be confirmed, or with no unit cost entered. They are left out of the total.
poSummary.expectedDeliveryTitle: When the supplier should deliver. Set to the day the order was raised unless you change it.
poSummary.primaryAddressPlaceholder: The supplier's primary address, unless chosen here

titles.job: The job this line's cost goes to when it is received. Leave it blank to put the material into workshop stock.
titles.priceTbc: Tick this when the supplier hasn't confirmed the cost yet. The unit cost is cleared and locked, and the line is left out of the total.
titles.unitCost: What we pay the supplier for one unit. Choosing a stock item fills this in from that item's cost.
titles.total: Quantity times unit cost for this line. Shows "—" until a unit cost is entered.

pickupModal.title: Pickup address for {{supplier}}
pickupModal.description: Choose where this order is collected from, or add an address.
pickupModal.confirmBody: {{name}} will no longer be offered for this supplier's orders.
pickupModal.empty: No pickup addresses yet for this supplier.
pickupModal.name: Name
pickupModal.isPrimary: Primary pickup address for this supplier

stock.setupFirst: Open Purchases → Stocktake to complete setup first.
stock.title: Stock
stock.recordFoundTitle: Starts a new, empty stocktake so you can add material that is in the workshop but not yet in DocketWorks. Nothing changes in stock until that stocktake is posted.
stock.includeRetiredTitle: Also show stock items that were retired because they ran out. Retired items keep their history.
stock.recordCountTitle: Starts a new stocktake with this item already on it, ready to count. Only shown for workshop stock that isn't on a job.
stock.historyTitle: Shows every delivery, issue to a job, return and stocktake change for this item.
stock.retireTitle: Removes this item from the stock list and searches. Only offered when its quantity is zero; its history is kept.
stock.drawerDescription: Recorded receipts, issues, returns and stocktake corrections.

titles.code: The item code this material has in Xero.
titles.metal: If this was left blank when the item was added, DocketWorks fills it in from the description, so check it before relying on it.
titles.alloy: If this was left blank when the item was added, DocketWorks fills it in from the description, so check it before relying on it.
titles.spec: If this was left blank when the item was added, DocketWorks fills it in from the description, so check it before relying on it.
titles.quantity: How much of this item DocketWorks has on record right now. It goes up with deliveries and found material and down when material goes to a job, and can go below zero if more was used than was on record.
titles.unitCost: What we pay for one unit of this item. Material sent to a job is costed at this.

movements.jobMaterialLoadFailed: Unable to load job material history.
movements.returnIssueTitle: Puts the whole amount sent to this job back into workshop stock and takes the same cost and revenue back off the job. Can only be done once for each issue.

titles.recorded: When this change to the stock was recorded in DocketWorks.
titles.beforeAfter: How much of this item was on record just before and just after this change.
titles.counterpart: The job the material went to or came from. Where no job is involved, such as a delivery or an opening balance, it names the kind of change instead.
titles.reasonOperator: Why the stock changed, and the staff member who recorded it. No name means DocketWorks recorded it automatically.

stocktakeList.title: Stocktake
stocktakeList.setupExplanation: Create the ongoing, non-billable Stocktake Adjustments job to record found and missing material.
stocktakeList.setUpTitle: Creates the "Stocktake Adjustments" job once. Found and missing material is booked against it, and customers are never charged for it.

titles.date: When the stocktake was started, not when it was posted.
titles.countedBy: The staff member who started this stocktake.
titles.status: Draft: counts can still be changed and stock hasn't moved. Posted: the differences have been applied to stock and can't be edited, only corrected.
titles.difference: The cost of what was counted minus the cost of what DocketWorks had on record, for every counted item. Positive means more was found than recorded; negative means material is missing. Uncounted items aren't included.

stocktakePicker.empty: No matching workshop stock. Use Add found item for new material.

stocktakeGrid.recountTitle: Stock for this item changed after you counted it. This updates the recorded quantity and clears your count so you can count it again.

titles.recorded: How much DocketWorks had on record for this item when it was added to the count. Found items start at zero.
titles.counted: What you physically found. Leave it blank if you didn't count it; enter 0 if there is none.
titles.unitCost: What we pay for one unit. Fixed for items already in stock; enter it for found items.
titles.difference: Counted minus recorded. Positive means more was found than recorded; negative means some is missing.
titles.value: The cost of the difference: difference times unit cost.
titles.reason: Why the count differs from the record. Needed for every line with a difference before the stocktake can be posted, and shown in the item's stock history.

stocktakeDetail.refreshFailed: Unable to refresh. Your entries have been retained.
stocktakeDetail.reloadFailed: Unable to reload. Your entries have been retained.
stocktakeDetail.unitCostRequired: Enter a unit cost for every found item.
stocktakeDetail.title: Stocktake · {{date}}
stocktakeDetail.adjustmentJobTitle: The job that found and missing material is booked against when a stocktake is posted. Customers are never charged for it.
stocktakeDetail.originalTitle: Opens the posted stocktake this one corrects.
stocktakeDetail.instructions: Count unassigned workshop material. Leave uncounted items blank; enter zero when nothing is present.
stocktakeDetail.showPickerTitle: Search workshop stock that isn't on a job and add items to this count.
stocktakeDetail.addFoundTitle: Adds a line for material that isn't in DocketWorks yet. Enter its description, count and cost; it becomes a new stock item when the stocktake is posted.
stocktakeDetail.progressTitle: Items on this stocktake, and how many have a count entered. Items left blank are not changed when posted.
stocktakeDetail.conflict: This draft was saved elsewhere. Reloading will replace your retained entries with the saved draft.
stocktakeDetail.saveFailed: Unable to save stocktake. Your entries have been retained.
stocktakeDetail.saveDraftTitle: Saves your counts without changing stock. You must save before you can post.
stocktakeDetail.postedRefreshFailed: Posted, but current stock could not be refreshed.
stocktakeDetail.postTitle: Applies every counted difference to stock and books its cost to the Stocktake Adjustments job. It can't be edited afterwards; use Create correction to fix it.
stocktakeDetail.checkStockTitle: Re-reads current stock so you can see whether anything changed since you counted it. Lines that changed must be recounted before posting.
stocktakeDetail.createCorrectionTitle: Starts a new draft stocktake for the same items, using today's quantities, so a wrong count can be put right. The original posting is kept.
stocktakeDetail.postedNote: Posted {{date}}. Surplus moves from the adjustment job into workshop stock; shortages move the other way.
